izna heats up Asia with sold-out WHO DAT GIRL? tour - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 22일(목) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment izna heats up Asia with sold-out WHO DAT GIRL? tour 
 입력 2026.10.22. 08:10 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 The group izna received praise from major local media as a "K-pop all-rounder group" and completed its concert tour.
 izna (Mai, Bang Ji-min, Coco, Yoo Sa-rang, Choi Jeong-eun, Jeong Se-bi) recently successfully completed the concert tour 2026-2027 izna Concert Tour: WHO DAT GIRL? (hereafter "WHO DAT GIRL?") in Taipei and Manila.
 Local major media continued to focus on izna's activities. China Times, SETN, yamNews and Enews noted that izna overwhelmed audiences by performing five consecutive full-band songs at the start of the show and reported that the members' perfect synchronized choreography presented high musical completeness and intense visuals at the same time.
 Liberty Times, Yahoo News, Line today and Tai Sounds showed strong interest in the unit stages. Mai, Yoo Sa-rang and Jeong Se-bi covered Girls' Generation's "Kissing You," while Bang Ji-min, Coco and Choi Jeong-eun performed aespa's "도깨비불 (Illusion)," and the contrasting concepts shifting between lovely and chic were highlighted as viewing points.
 Also, Mirror Daily News and mnews emphasized that member Choi Jeong-eun made a surprise appearance from the audience to open the show. The staging that cohesively showcased the eye-catching charm of "DAT GIRL" even amid a crowd was impressive. Youth Daily News called izna a "K-pop all-rounder group," conveying the six members' outstanding musical abilities.
 In addition, ABS-CBN News noted that the two hours flew by with diverse music and infectious energy, and Manila Bulletin pointed out that from stages combining music and choreography to cover performances, they delivered special enjoyment and roused fans' enthusiasm.
 Through its debut concert tour "WHO DAT GIRL?", izna is imprinting its global presence by heating up Seoul, Taipei and Manila in succession.
 izna, which has been receiving strong responses for communicating closely with fans in local languages, showcasing trending local challenges and even singing a popular OST line, is a reason to look forward to its upcoming concert tour.
